title: Late in the Evening - Wikipedia
notes: A New York City-style Cuban mozambique groove by Gadd, played with two pairs of sticks, one in each hand, to sound like two drummers; Ralph MacDonald on cowbell and temple blocks.

title: Steve Gadd, Advanced Groupings & Fills (Drum Guru lesson, Hudson Music)
notes: His own lesson: a three-note grouping in 2-, 4- and 8-bar phrases, and how he used it in the Love for Sale break on Burning for Buddy.
